title: Attackers and defenders

steps.text: Count before you capture. The pawn on e5 is attacked twice, by the knight and the bishop, and defended once, by the knight on c6.
Two attackers against one defender: capture the pawn with your knight.
steps.after: Black's knight captured back. Now your bishop is the second attacker.
Knights traded, and you have an extra pawn.

steps.text: Count again. Tap every white piece that attacks the pawn on d5.
steps.after: Two attackers: a pawn and a knight.

steps.text: Now tap every black piece that defends d5.
steps.after: Two defenders, a pawn and the queen. Capturing twice on d5 would lose a knight for a pawn.

summary: Count attackers and defenders. Capture when you have more attackers, and capture first with the piece worth less.
